title: hibiscus solandra
intro: Hibiscus solandra, commonly known as the "Cotton Rose", is a flowering plant species belonging to the Malvaceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and acting as a natural diuretic. The therapeutic actions of Hibiscus solandra are attributed to its ability to relax smooth muscles, improve cardiovascular health, and provide antioxidant protection. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, such as kaempferol and quercetin, as well as anthocyanins and other phenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
